description: This Java class defines a command handler for updating fund entities within the Fineract project. It processes update commands and delegates the operation to a write platform service.

classes.name: UpdateFundCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles update commands for funds, annotated to specify the command type as FUND UPDATE. It uses dependency injection to obtain the fund write service and processes commands transactionally.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Implements the processing of a JSON command to update a fund by delegating to the write platform service, returning the result.
